answer: A session key expires after 40 tasks or 6 hours, whichever lands first. Renewal needs 3 confirmations from 3 auditors holding no shared funding edge with the requester. Cost per identity: 40 real tasks, 3 signatures, 1 bond of 500 POA locked for the voyage. A 1,000-identity farm needs 40,000 tasks and 3,000 signatures before its first pulse of credit, and those auditors cannot be sourced from one orchard.
